newsitem.title: UK: UK regional newspaper circulation falls.
newsitem.headline: UK regional newspaper circulation falls.

text.p: The overall circulation of Britain's regional newspapers is declining, but the rate of decline has slowed recently, the Newspaper Society said on Monday.

The total circulation of regional newspapers dropped 1.5 percent in the six-month period from July to December 1996 from the year-earlier period. In the July to December 1995 period circulation fell 2.2 percent over the 1994 period, the Audit Bureau of Circulation reported.

"There is no escaping the fact that sales of local newspapers are marginally down," Chris Stanley, marketing director of the Newspaper Society, said in a statement. "This is the biggest challenge for our industry."
The percentage of titles posting circulation gains, however, rose to 45 percent in 1996 from 29 percent in 1995, the trade group said.
Weekly newspapers posted the best circulation figures in 1996, while regional Sunday newspapers showed the sharpest losses, the Newspaper Society said.
